'''District 1''' was the first and lowest level of the [[City/Legends|city]] known as the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]]<ref name="Spire" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=kotfe|Zakuul}}</ref> Like all of the other districts or levels of the Spire, District 1 was labyrinthian in design and boasted a variety of [[Museum/Legends|museums]], [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], and other entertainment venues. All of the districts were constructed with identical living conditions to each other per the orders of the [[Immortality/Legends|Immortal]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]]. Although [[Zakuulan]] society was designed to be classless, the inhabitants of lower districts were still considered lower-class, and District 1&mdash;which was located just above the decrepit [[Old World|Oldtown]]&mdash;was considered the lowest level.<ref name="Spire" />

==Behind the scenes==
District 1 was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Spire in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The Codex entry was part of Chapter X,<ref name="Spire" /> which was added to the game on [[February 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb/Patch|4.1}}</ref>
